name: ntulearn-mcp
description: MCP server for NTULearn (NTU Singapore's Blackboard Learn). Announcements, assignments, grades, messages, users/groups, and course files — across all your enrolled courses.
long_description:
Lets Claude answer questions like "what's due next week?", "what announcements went out this week?", "who's in my tutorial group?", "show me every file in this course", and "organise my semester files into ~/NTU/y3s1/…" — fanning out across all your enrolled courses automatically.

Authenticates via the BbRouter cookie — auto-read from your browser on macOS / Linux / Windows-with-Firefox. Windows + Chrome/Edge users paste the cookie into the field below (Claude Desktop stores it in your OS keychain).

Tools: list_courses, get_course_contents (with folder drill-down), get_upcoming (calendar + assignment due dates), get_announcements (cross-course, with since filter), get_gradebook (cross-course), search_course_content, download_file (with destination_dir for folder hierarchies), read_file_content (text extraction from PDFs / Office files; vision opt-in for diagrams), plus v0.3: list_messages / read_message (mailbox), list_course_users / list_course_groups / get_group_members (roster), get_gradebook_attempts (submissions), search_all_courses (cross-course content search), get_content_tree (whole nested tree), download_course (recursive course download), whats_new (digest), export_calendar_ics, export_gradebook_csv, and summarize_course (one-call course briefing).

bbrouter_cookie.title: BbRouter cookie (optional)
bbrouter_cookie.description: Leave empty to auto-read from your browser. Required on Windows + Chrome/Edge (browser auto-read is blocked there). To get the value: log into ntulearn.ntu.edu.sg, open DevTools → Application → Cookies → ntulearn.ntu.edu.sg, copy the BbRouter cookie value.

tools.name: ntulearn_list_courses
tools.description: List the user's enrolled NTULearn courses.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_course_contents
tools.description: Get the content tree of a course. Omit parent_id for the root; pass it to drill into a folder.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_upcoming
tools.description: Calendar items across enrolled courses for the next 2 weeks. type='GradebookColumn' filters to assignment due dates.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_announcements
tools.description: Announcements across all enrolled courses, newest first. Optional since (ISO-8601) for a time window.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_gradebook
tools.description: Gradebook columns and scores across all enrolled courses.

tools.name: ntulearn_search_course_content
tools.description: Recursive substring search within one course's content tree.

tools.name: ntulearn_download_file
tools.description: Download a content item's files to disk. destination_dir accepts absolute paths and ~/… prefixes.

tools.name: ntulearn_read_file_content
tools.description: Read an attached file inline — text mode by default (PDF/docx/pptx/xlsx); pass mode='vision' for diagram pages.

tools.name: ntulearn_list_messages
tools.description: List the user's Blackboard mailbox messages (inbox/sent), optionally unread or since a cutoff.

tools.name: ntulearn_read_message
tools.description: Read a single message by ID, including body and recipients.

tools.name: ntulearn_list_course_users
tools.description: List users enrolled in a course.

tools.name: ntulearn_list_course_groups
tools.description: List the groups defined in a course.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_group_members
tools.description: List the members of a specific course group.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_gradebook_attempts
tools.description: List submission attempts for a gradebook column, with optional user_id scope.

tools.name: ntulearn_search_all_courses
tools.description: Recursive substring search across ALL enrolled courses' content trees.

tools.name: ntulearn_get_content_tree
tools.description: Return a course's entire content tree as nested JSON.

tools.name: ntulearn_download_course
tools.description: Recursively download every file in a course's content tree to disk.

tools.name: ntulearn_whats_new
tools.description: Digest of announcements, upcoming due dates, and gradebook summary since a cutoff.

tools.name: ntulearn_export_calendar_ics
tools.description: Export calendar items (incl. due dates) as an iCalendar (.ics) string.

tools.name: ntulearn_export_gradebook_csv
tools.description: Export gradebook columns and scores as a CSV string.

tools.name: ntulearn_summarize_course
tools.description: Bite-size briefing of a single course: title, instructors, upcoming, announcements, grades, top folders.
